description: Payment estimates at today's MonitorBankRates average rate for the state (or national), or a rate you pass. calculator = mortgage (monthly principal and interest; pass amount, or home_price and optional down_payment), refinance (new payment, and with current_rate the monthly savings and breakeven months), home_equity_loan (fixed payment), heloc (interest only payment during the draw period, payment once repayment starts, and the payment if the rate rises 1 point), or auto. Returns the inputs and assumptions used and a link to the matching MonitorBankRates calculator page.

amount.description: Loan amount or balance in dollars.

closing_costs.description: Refinance only: closing costs in dollars (default 2% of the balance).

current_rate.description: Refinance only: rate on the current loan, in percent.

current_years_left.description: Refinance only: years left on the current loan.

down_payment.description: Mortgage only: down payment in dollars (default 20% of home_price).

draw_years.description: HELOC only: draw period in years (default 10).

home_price.description: Mortgage only: home price, used when amount is not given.

rate.description: Optional interest rate in percent. Omit to use today's MonitorBankRates average.

state.description: Optional two-letter state code or name, for the state average rate.

years.description: Loan term in years (HELOC: the repayment period). Defaults: mortgage and refinance 30, home equity loan 15, HELOC 20, auto 5.

name: calculate_loan
title: Loan payment calculator
